theme_desc: 日本夏夜妖怪祭典：祭典攤販、狐面、妖怪與月宮，走可愛明亮的夜祭調性，不走陰森
theme_en: Japanese summer night yokai festival (百鬼夜宴), cheerful and cute, bright colors, nothing grim or creepy

dressing_room.name: 【人物更衣室】
dressing_room.desc: 夏祭夜：左半木造圓形祭典舞台，後方掛滿紅燈籠的木拱門，最左側少量攤位，星空遠處煙火；右半深靛藍純色
dressing_room.prompt_en: the stage is a round wooden festival stage; behind it a tall wooden festival arch strung with red paper lanterns; a few food stalls at the far left edge; starry summer night sky with small distant fireworks. Right half colour: deep indigo.

requirements: 服飾：藏青法被搭配白領、深色短褲、草鞋，無花紋
髮飾：白色綁額頭巾（hachimaki）
整體簡樸，無武器無特效
male.prompt_en: festival stall vendor. Navy blue happi coat with a plain white collar, white headband (hachimaki) tied on the forehead, dark shorts, straw sandals, friendly smile.

requirements: 服飾：粉色浴衣，小碎花即可，紅色腰帶
髮飾：小金魚髮飾
鞋：木屐；整體簡樸，無武器無特效
female.prompt_en: yukata girl. Soft pink yukata with a simple small floral pattern, red obi sash, a small goldfish hair ornament, wooden geta sandals, shy smile.

foregrounds.name: 【前景1】撈金魚
foregrounds.desc: 撈金魚的水盆，盆裡兩尾金魚，旁邊一支紙網（poi）
foregrounds.prompt_en: a goldfish-scooping bowl with two small goldfish and a paper scoop (poi).

foregrounds.name: 【前景2】狐面
foregrounds.desc: 白底紅紋的狐狸面具，附紅繩與小鈴
foregrounds.prompt_en: a white kitsune fox mask with red markings and a red cord.

requirements: 服飾：白底紅狐火紋羽織，內搭深色和服
髮飾：半面狐面戴在側頭
武器：一把太刀（擇武器，不做特效）
male.prompt_en: fox-mask swordsman. White haori with red fox-flame patterns over a dark kimono, a half fox mask worn on the side of the head as a hair accessory, holding ONE katana (his weapon; no glowing effects).

requirements: 服飾：橙白振袖和服
髮飾：狐耳
特效（虛體）：身旁漂浮藍白狐火（擇特效，不拿武器）
武器(人物系統)：由美術配一把摺扇或鈴杖
female.prompt_en: nine-tailed fox girl. Orange and white furisode kimono, fox ears hair accessory, fluffy fox tails behind her, surrounded by floating blue-white fox-fire wisps (her effect; she holds NO weapon).

foregrounds.name: 【前景】祭典太鼓
foregrounds.desc: 祭典用太鼓，附兩支鼓棒
foregrounds.prompt_en: a festival taiko drum with two drumsticks.

background.name: 【背景】夜祭參道
background.desc: 夜間祭典參道，兩側紅燈籠與攤位，暖色燈光；不要畫鳥居與石燈籠
background.prompt_en: a night festival approach path lined with red paper lanterns and food stalls, warm lantern glow, no torii gate, no stone lanterns.

requirements: 服飾：紅黑裝束，黑羽毛領，不放任何宗教物件
髮飾：小型紅色高鼻天狗面具戴在額頭
武器：羽團扇（擇武器，不做特效）
male.prompt_en: young tengu boy. Red and black outfit without any religious items, a small red long-nosed tengu mask worn on his forehead, black feathered collar, holding ONE large feather fan (hauchiwa, his weapon; no glowing effects).

requirements: 服飾：淺藍白雪花紋和服，可愛不陰森
髮飾：雪花髮簪
特效（實體）：身旁飄落冰晶與雪花（擇特效，不拿武器）
武器(人物系統)：由美術配一把冰紋團扇
female.prompt_en: snow woman (yuki-onna), cute and gentle, not scary. Pale ice-blue and white kimono with snowflake patterns, long pale hair, a snowflake hair pin, soft glowing ice crystals and snowflakes drifting around her (her effect; she holds NO weapon).

foregrounds.name: 【前景】和傘
foregrounds.prompt_en: a red oil-paper umbrella (wagasa), half open.

background.name: 【背景】雪夜竹林
background.desc: 月夜下的雪竹林，藍白色調，細雪飄落；不要畫鳥居與石燈籠
background.prompt_en: a snowy bamboo grove at night under moonlight, blue-white tones, gentle falling snow, no torii gate, no stone lanterns.

groups.head_note: (本次神娃不做儲值裝，僅人物系統)

requirements: 服飾：赤金色鬼武者鎧甲，肩甲帶鬼面裝飾
髮飾：一對鬼角
武器：金棒（鐵棒）
翅膀：不放
male.prompt_en: oni samurai. Crimson and gold ornate samurai armor with an oni-face shoulder guard, two short horns, holding a studded iron club (kanabo).

requirements: 服飾：紫金華麗振袖，金色腰帶
髮飾：一對小鬼角搭配金簪
武器：金色薙刀
翅膀：不放
female.prompt_en: oni princess. Luxurious purple and gold furisode with a gold obi, two small horns with golden hairpins, holding a golden naginata.

requirements: 服飾：黑紅金鬼王鎧甲，毛領
髮飾：一對大彎角
武器：巨型華麗大太刀，另一手漂浮金酒杯
特效（虛體）：紅金酒焰環繞，腰間赤色注連繩尾端飄舞
翅膀(人物系統)：以飄舞的注連繩與藍色鬼火代替，造型由美術設計
male.prompt_en: Shuten-doji oni king. Black, red and gold ornate oni armor, two large curved horns, wild hair, holding a huge ornate odachi sword in one hand and a floating golden sake cup in the other, surrounded by swirling red-gold sake flames; instead of wings, long crimson shimenawa rope ends and small blue oni-fire wisps flare out from his back.

requirements: 服飾：金白華麗十二單，金色髮飾
髮飾：金狐耳與花簪
武器：大型金扇
特效（實體）：九條金色狐尾如翼展開，金狐火環繞
翅膀(人物系統)：以九尾代替，造型由美術設計
female.prompt_en: Tamamo-no-Mae nine-tailed fox queen. Luxurious gold and white layered junihitoe kimono with ornate gold hair ornaments, nine large golden fox tails fanned out behind her like wings, holding a large golden folding fan as her weapon, golden fox-fire orbs orbiting her.

foregrounds.name: 【前景】Q版狸貓
foregrounds.desc: Q 版狸貓，頭頂一片葉子，手提小燈籠
foregrounds.prompt_en: a chibi tanuki raccoon-dog with a leaf on its head holding a tiny lantern.

background.name: 【背景】鬼城天守(滿版)
background.desc: 紅月下的鬼城天守閣，燈籠與飄散火星
background.prompt_en: a towering oni castle keep at night under a red moon, lanterns and drifting embers.

requirements: 服飾：青藍鱗甲鑲金邊
髮飾：一對龍角
武器：華麗三叉戟
特效（虛體）：發光水流纏身，身旁一條水流化成的小水龍
翅膀(人物系統)：以背後兩道發光水弧代替，造型由美術設計
male.prompt_en: dragon god of the sea (ryujin). Teal-blue scaled armor with gold trim, two dragon horns, flowing dark-blue hair, holding an ornate trident, a spiraling stream of glowing water with a small water dragon coiling around his body; instead of wings, two arcs of luminous water rise from his back.

requirements: 服飾：月白銀十二單，淡紫點綴
髮飾：新月髮冠
武器：新月法杖
特效（虛體）：銀色月光粒子與發光竹葉飄落
翅膀(人物系統)：以飄揚羽衣飄帶代替，造型由美術設計
female.prompt_en: Princess Kaguya, moon princess. Moon-white and silver layered junihitoe kimono with pale lavender accents, a crescent-moon crown, long flowing celestial robe ribbons (hagoromo) floating behind her like wings, holding a crescent-moon staff as her weapon, soft silver moonlight sparkles and floating glowing bamboo leaves around her.

foregrounds.name: 【前景】月兔
foregrounds.desc: Q 版白色月兔，抱著小搗麻糬木槌
foregrounds.prompt_en: a chibi white moon rabbit holding a small mochi mallet.

background.name: 【背景】月宮(滿版)
background.desc: 發光的月宮與竹林，深藍夜空一輪滿月
background.prompt_en: a luminous moon palace with glowing bamboo and a huge full moon in a deep indigo sky.
